mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are currently clear with a temperature of 40 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail under a New Moon.

The City of Verona has announced that pavement repairs will take place on Tuesday, November 10, and Wednesday, November 11. Contractors will be milling and patching several roads including North Nine Mound Road and Morningside Boulevard, with paving to follow. No parking signs will be enforced from 7 AM to 7 PM on both days.
Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead, tomorrow is a busy day with trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza at Lake Lou-ee.
In a report regarding service calls, officers dealt with an incident on October 25 where a 40-year-old man was located in his vehicle at an intersection and subsequently arrested for an O W I.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Georgia Peach. The Culver's in Verona opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by once they open.
